description:
Take one person off your blocked list, so they can apply to your bounties again. Does not add them to your preferred list.
Use for: undoing block_human.
Not for: seeing who you blocked (list_blocked_humans).
Needs: an API key. Hosted sign-in cannot call this yet.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: unblock_human({"humanId":"h2Lw9QxT4mZp7Rk"})
Repeat: A repeat with the same input, and the same key if you sent one, does not act twice: it returns the same result, finishes the first call, or is refused.
Errors: account_setup_required; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

humanId.description: The human id, as `id` in list_humans.

name: unblock_human

wasBlocked.description: True when they were on your blocked list and are now off it. False when they were not on it.

title: Unblock a human
